top_choice_rationale: P002 honours a specific, non-obvious prediction (the 2011 Bistritzer-MacDonald flat-band continuum model, a joint two-author paper, so all three names are warranted) followed by the 2018 discovery of correlated insulating and superconducting states, reproduced by many groups and opening a new regime of quantum matter. The citation is limited to the prediction and the observed phases, so the unresolved pairing mechanism does not affect what is honoured. I accept that the credit boundary (Cao and other experimental groups) is its weakest point and that P001 is cleaner on credit and maturity, which is why P001 is second. P003 is third because of the contested third seat and the 2016 topology prize overlap, and P000 is last since several mature, secure achievements are available.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; my work is in string theory, quantum gravity and cosmology, with no documented tie to MacDonald, Bistritzer, Jarillo-Herrero, Katori, Ye, Kane, Mele or Molenkamp.
